description:
Hiring: AI Content Creation VA (Short-Form Video)



We are a social media content company that creates short-form video content for health and wellness brands on Instagram. We use AI tools to generate images, voiceovers, talking head videos, and motion clips, then edit everything together into finished Instagram Reels.



This is a long-term position, not a one-time project.



What you will be doing:



- Using AI tools to generate realistic images of characters (Nano Banana Pro)

- Generating natural sounding voiceovers (ElevenLabs)

- Creating talking head videos (HeyGen)

- Generating motion video clips (Google Veo 3)

- Editing everything together into polished short-form videos (CapCut or your preferred editing software)

- Using Claude AI to write prompts and improve your work quality



You do not need prior experience with these specific tools. We have a full 9-stage onboarding program that trains you on everything step by step. But you do need to be someone who learns fast and pays attention to detail.



What we are looking for:



- Reliable and consistent. You show up every day and communicate if something comes up. This is the number one thing we care about.

- Detail-oriented. The difference between a good video and a bad one comes down to small details.

- Coachable. You take feedback seriously and apply it to your next video.

- Has their own laptop or desktop computer with a stable internet connection.

- Has their own video editing software (CapCut works great).

- Can follow instructions carefully without needing to be told the same thing twice.



Schedule:



Monday through Saturday. Daily check-in at 9:00 AM PHT. All work for the day must be completed and submitted by 9:00 PM PHT.



Pay:



$500 per month.



Onboarding:



Before you start producing content, you will go through our 9-stage onboarding program. Onboarding is unpaid but mandatory and must be completed within 7 days. This deadline is non-negotiable. It is designed to fully prepare you so you can do the job at a high level from day one. If onboarding is not completed within 7 days we will not be moving forward.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

title: Meta Ads Manager
description:
Meta Ads Manager modAmbition | Dr. Tiffany Shelton

Location: Fully remote Hours: 10 hours per week (with surge during launch periods) 

Start: June 15, 2026 

Job Type: Freelance 1099 contractor position

Hey, I'm Dr. Tiffany. I'm the founder of modAmbition, a brand and content ecosystem for women who want to build a life that feels spacious and sustainable. I'm a neuropsychologist by training, an entrepreneur by passion, and a wife and mom of two by the grace of God.

I've been working with an outside agency for our Meta ads, and after a thorough look at the numbers, I'm bringing this work in house. I want someone embedded with our brand who knows our voice, our funnels, and our audience the way only an in house partner can. I have a launch in August and ongoing evergreen lead generation that needs steady hands.

So I'm hiring my Meta Ads Manager.

Who You'd Be Helping

My audience is ambitious women who are smart, driven, and quietly tired. They're moms, entrepreneurs, executives, and creatives who've built impressive lives and want to keep building with their nervous systems intact. My content gives them practical systems backed by neuroscience and softened by faith and grace.

My brand sits at the intersection of productivity, neuroscience, and faith based personal development. Knowing how this audience thinks and what they respond to is half the job here.

What You'd Own

You'd run the entire Meta ads program. Here's how that breaks down.

Strategy and structure You'd build campaign structure for both launches and evergreen lead generation. You'd design the audience targeting, set up the creative testing framework, and pace the budget across the month.

Launch campaigns For each course launch (next one is August 2026), you'd plan the full ad sequence from awareness through close. You'd brief the creative needs, pull copy from our organic content, and run the creative testing during the launch window.

Evergreen funnels You'd run ongoing top of funnel ads to grow our
 list and book launch waitlist. You'd watch the funnel metrics, identify what's working, and shift budget toward winners.

Reporting Each week, you'd send a short performance summary covering spend, results by campaign, what changed, and what you're testing next. A clean weekly note in Slack or Notion is all I need.

Coordination You'd work alongside our Content Producer who handles organic YouTube and Instagram. They produce the creative assets and on brand visuals. You take what's working in organic and turn it into ad creative that converts.

Who You Probably Are

You live inside Meta Ads Manager. You know the platform deeply, including the dashboard quirks, the policy gotchas, and how to read the data underneath the surface metrics.

You've run ads for creators, coaches, or boutique brands in the $3K to $20K per month spend range. You understand that small spend takes a different kind of thinking than enterprise spend.

You've supported at least 3 to 5 course launches end to end. You know what the launch funnel looks like, how to brief creative, and how to manage budget pacing across the open cart window.

We utilize cutting-edge technology—including heavy-lift custom drones, professional softwash systems, and advanced water-fed purification window cleaning gear—to safely restore and maintain commercial complexes, historic properties, residential estates, and industrial assets.

We are seeking a rare professional who can manage both our digital field tracking pipeline (CRM operations) and our forward-facing brand authority (Social Media & Video Production).



In my previous career, I worked for software company in the US and I had teams in the Philippines (Manilla) for the past 17 years.  I've visited your beautiful country many times and still in touch with my former team.



Role Overview

As our Social Media & CRM Operations Manager, you will sit at the crossroads of our field operations and our customer acquisition pipeline.



On the creative side, you will take raw field footage (GoPro, iPhone, and 4K aerial drone clips) captured by our crews in the DMV area and engineer high-engagement, highly satisfying short-for
dia. You will be responsible for editing, annotating, and deploying content daily.



On the systems side, you will act as our operational data anchor—translating scanned daily field sheets from our technicians into organized, actionable records within our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform and our dedicated safety/i
 tracking system.



Core Responsibilities

1. CRM Administration & Field Data Processing

Daily Work Sheet Ingestion: Review scanned copies of daily employee project worksheets submitted by our field crews. Accurately transcribe and enter key data points into our CRM system, including:



Project Documentation: Transcribing general field notes, structural observations, and pre-existing property conditions.



Labor Tracking: Logging precise project start and stop times to maintain accurate job-costing metrics.



Chemical Application Logs: Recording exact chemical mixes used on site (e.g., Sodium Hypochlorite ratios, surfactants, or specialized neutralizers) and tracking raw material consumption.



I
 & Safety Tracking: Review field sheets for any reported field anomalies, near-misses, or equipment failures. Extract and log this critical data into our dedicated i
 and a
 management tracking tool to support our proactive risk-mitigation protocols.



Lead Management & Inbound Nurturing: Monitor incoming leads arriving in the CRM database. Manage initial client touchpoints exclusively via professional text and
 communication (no voice calls required) to qualify leads and guide them cleanly into our bidding pipeline.



2. Social Media Creation & Daily Management

Daily Multi-Platform Posting: Execute a rigorous, daily posting schedule across platforms critical to the Washington D.C. Metro market 
, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts).



Video Engineering & Editing: Take raw, unedited footage of satisfying cleaning sequences (before/after transformations, drone flight lines, surface cleaning arcs) and cut them into pristine, high-impact vertical videos (9:16) using tools like CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or DaVinci Resolve.



Media Annotation & Value Inlays: Add clean, professional text overlays, captioning, trending audio tracks, and graphic callouts (using Canva and advanced video effects) that educate the audience on how and why we clean scientifically.



Local Brand Positioning: Tailor captions and hashtags to resonate with property managers, HOAs, commercial real estate developers, and high-end homeowners in the Northern Virginia, D.C., and Maryland corridors.



3. Brand Safety & Technical Integrity Gatekeeping

PPE & OSHA Compliance Review: Review all raw field footage prior to editing to guarantee our brand exhibits 100% safety compliance. You will actively screen out any footage showing technicians violating safety protocols (e.g., missing eye/face protection, improper respirator use during chemical transfer, or lack of fall protection/harnesses on roof pitches).



Chemical & Technical Accuracy: Ensure all video annotations and captions use accurate industry terminology. You will be trained by our leadership to distinguish between high-pressure blasting and low-pressure chemical softwashing, ensuring captions accurately explain how our chemical applications safely eliminate organic contaminants down to the spore without damaging delicate building materials.



Required Skills & Experience

Data Integrity & Speed: Exceptional accuracy and speed in data entry. Ability to read handwritten or scanned field worksheets and carefully extract technical data without errors.



Software Mastery: Proficient in CapCut (or professional equivalent video editor) and Canva for rapid, high-quality asset design.



CRM Familiarity: Proven experience navigating small business CRM frameworks, pipeline management, and client communication workflows.



Visual Storytelling Eye: An exceptional eye for rhythm, color correction, and pacing in video editing—specifically maximizing the "oddly satisfying" nature of exterior cleaning transformations.



Flawless Written English: Perfect command of English grammar and professional tone. Ability to write sophisticated captions for commercial property managers as well as engaging, punchy copy for residential homeowners.



Operational Reliability: A rock-solid remote working infrastructure, including a high-spec editing computer, lightning-fast internet, and a reliable power/internet backup solution to maintain daily consistency.



How to Apply (The Mandatory Screening Process)

We run a disciplined, high-standards operation. To ensure you possess the intense attention to detail required to manage our systems, your application must follow these instructions exactly:



Your application message must start with this exact phrase as the very first line: "Safety and Chemistry First Operations." (All applications missing this phrase will be archived automatically without review).



Provide a direct link to a portfolio or Google Drive folder showcasing short-form vertical videos (Reels/TikToks/Shorts) you have personally edited and annotated.



Answer this technical scenario question in 2–3 sentences:



Scenario: A raw clip shows a technician cleaning a high-end window pane with a water-fed pole, but another technician in the background has briefly taken off his safety glasses while near a chemical mixing tank. How do you handle this footage during the editing and publishing process to protect the company's brand safety?

title: Tech Lead
description:
WeFlex exists to increase the life expectancy and quality of life for people with a disability, people in aged care, and Australian war veterans — through access to physical fitness, allied health, and therapy supports.



We've delivered over 50,000 sessions of support across our network, grown 30x over the last 2.5 years, and want to continue at a rate of 100% year on year.



The seat

You'll own the technology engine that powers WeFlex's end-to-end customer lifecycle — lead acquisition through retention. Today it runs across Supabase, Airtable, n8n, GoHighLevel, Zendesk, Aircall, Wavix, Xero, and our internal portals. Tomorrow it's your call to architect.



You sit at the leadership table as a senior peer — reporting to our COO, partnering directly with the CEO, working alongside our Heads of Sales, CS, Marketing, and (soon) Service Providers.



This is a player-coach seat. You don't just architect — you build. Then you lead a team of 5 builders to ship alongside you. Big problems we're chewing on right now: the O2C rebuild (kill Zoho), the Supabase migration (centralise source-of-truth), the AHP supervision automation that's worth ~$185k/yr in revenue if we get it right.



AI augmentation is non-negotiable. We move at a pace where the only way to keep up is to have Claude / GPT / Cursor / equivalents deeply embedded in how you think and ship every day. If they're not already core to your workflow, this role isn't for you.



The 5 things you'll do day-to-day:



Set the technology strategy — what we build, what we migrate, what we kill. The 18-month roadmap is yours to author with the COO + CEO.

Architect + build — you write the spec, then you ship the work. We don't promote you out of code. The team builds with you, not for you.

Lead and grow the team — hire, performance manage, build capability, exit underperformers when needed. We have 5 builders today; you'll shape the next 10.

Partner directly with CEO + COO — translate ambiguous business problems into systems that work. "Clients aren't reporting back" ? you diagnose, scope, ship.

AI-augmented by default — Claude, GPT, Cursor, equivalent are part of how you ship every day, not just how you write
s. Show us your stack and a real recent build where AI was core to how you executed.

What we're looking for

We hire skills over credentials.



AI-augmented operator (non-negotiable). Your workflow runs through Claude / GPT / Cursor — diagnosing, scoping, building, documenting. If AI is bolted on rather than core, this role won't work.

Builder of systems with real artifacts. Operational systems / integrations / automations you've shipped end-to-end. Portfolio over CV. Show us the code, the flows, the Looms.

Architectural judgment at scale. You've made build-vs-buy / migrate-vs-rebuild calls. You've owned a platform decision and can defend it. You think in trade-offs, not absolutes.

Track record leading a small tech team. Hiring, performance management, capability building, hard conversations. We have 5 builders; you'll d
 who stays, who grows, who goes.

Translates ambiguous executive briefs into shipped systems. When the CEO says "we need to know which clients are at risk" — you diagnose, scope, build, ship. You don't wait for the perfect spec.

Degree, years-of-experience, prior industry — all signals, not gates. If your work speaks, your CV doesn't have to be conventional.



What this role does NOT involve

? Marketing tech / GHL funnel design ? marketing team owns this

? Direct customer service ? CS team owns Zendesk as a product

? Heavy DevOps / infrastructure architecture ? we're a small remote team running on managed services

? Mobile / native app development ? we run web + portal stack

Compensation

PHP 90,000–220,000 per month depending on experience and demonstrated capability

Fully remote, AEST-aligned working hours

Career trajectory: This is the technology counterpart to our COO-track seat. For the right person, ownership expands as we scale — through Head of Engineering and beyond — as WeFlex grows.

To apply

Submit your application here: 



The application has two parts:



Part 1 — Application form



Your CV

Portfolio link (GitHub, Loom library, case studies, live systems you've built)

3 short written answers

Notice period + salary expectation

Part 2 — Build task

A real WeFlex scenario with sample data. You build a working artifact and record a short Loom walking us through your thinking, your tool choice, and your AI workflow. No time limit — we score the quality of the build, not how fast you finished. Full briefing pack is provided when you start the application.



We hire builders, not talkers. The build task is the highest-weight signal in our process.

title: Content Marketing Producer
description:
Content Strategist modAmbition | Dr. Tiffany Shelton

Location: Fully remote Hours: 25 hours per week 

Start: June 15, 2026 Job Type: 

Freelance 1099 contractor position

Hey, I'm Dr. Tiffany. I'm the founder of modAmbition, a brand and content ecosystem for women who want to build a life that feels spacious and sustainable. I'm a neuropsychologist by training, an entrepreneur by passion, and a wife and mom of two by the grace of God.

I'm running two content channels (YouTube and Instagram) alongside our growing
 list, and preparing for a course launch in August. I've been carrying the research, packaging, and creative direction myself, and the channels need someone who can hold the strategy side alongside me so they can actually grow.

So I'm hiring my Content Strategist.

Who You'd Be Helping

My audience is ambitious women who are smart, driven, and quietly tired. They're moms, entrepreneurs, executives, and creatives who've built impressive lives and want to keep building with their nervous systems intact. My content gives them practical systems backed by neuroscience and softened by faith and grace.

My brand sits at the intersection of productivity, neuroscience, and faith based personal development. If that world already lives in your watch history and your feed, you'll feel right at home here.

What You'd Own

This is a collaborative role. I provide the topics and the teachings. You research, package, and shape each piece so it actually lands.

Here's how that breaks down.

YouTube research and packaging

I'll send you 4 video topics at a time. From there, you'd:

Research validated packaging using tools like ViewStats and 1of10 (outlier thumbnails and titles in our niche)

Bring me 3 thumbnail concepts and a handful of title variations for each video

Write the intro for each video (hook, framing, and why this matters to my audience)

Manage the editor handoff once I batch film, and run point on the review cycle

Watch performance after each video is published so we know what to do more of.

Instagram research and frameworks

Each week, you'd deliver a research package for 3 Instagram posts that we’ll work together to create. Each post framework includes:

Validated topics that align with what's working in our niche

Hooks for each carousel or broll reel tested against current content trends

Inspiration posts for each (an example we can reference for structure or angle)

Notes on the angle or series this fits into

Once I provide copy for the actual value provided in the carousel or reel (beyond the hook you created), you'd design 2 to 3 carousels per week, and create 1 broll reel per week, and hand them off to our executive assistant for scheduling. 

Finally based on the final carousel or reel created, you’d write captions in our voice. 

You'd also help me validate series ideas and longer arcs for Instagram so we have a clearer editorial direction month to month.

Coordination

You'd run point with the editor and any other tea
mbers in the content pipeline. You'd own the briefs, the feedback, and the timelines so I can stay focused on creating and coaching.

Who You Probably Are

You live in content. You scroll YouTube and Instagram the way some people watch the Super Bowl, with strong opinions about hooks, packaging, and what makes someone stop mid scroll.

You love research and pattern recognition. You can spend an afternoon inside ViewStats or analyzing top performing Instagram accounts and come out energized.

You're plugged into content for ambitious women. You follow the creators making it, watch how it resonates, and notice the trends shifting in this space.

You take deadlines seriously. When you say something will be done by Friday, it's done by Friday. If something comes up, you flag it early.

You're warm and direct. You can give and receive feedback without ego. You ask good questions and you don't make excuses.

You're a fluent English speaker and writer. The intros and hooks you write have to feel like me, and that takes a real ear for tone and rhythm.

You've got at least 1 to 2 years of experience in YouTube research, packaging, or content strategy work. Bonus if you've supported a course launch.

A Note On AI

The writing has to be yours. I'm hiring a real human creative partner who can think, feel, and craft alongside me. If I wanted intros and hooks that AI wrote, I could generate those myself.

AI is fine as a research helper or a brainstorm tool. The intros, hooks, and writing that go out under my name need to come from your brain and your voice. That's the whole job.

Tools We'll Use

Notion and Google Drive for daily work. YouTube and 1of10 for YouTube research. Klaviyo for
 coordination and Calendly for scheduling.

What I'm Offering

You'll have flexibility on your hours and schedule. Outside of agreed deadlines and meetings, you run your own day.

You'll work in a trust based environment. I don't micromanage. I set clear expectations and trust you to deliver.

There's real growth potential here. As the brand grows, your role and pay can grow with it. I want the right person to be here for the long haul.

You'll be part of a creative partnership rooted in something deeper than hustle. The content we make helps women all over the world build calmer, more aligned lives.

Compensation

Compensation will be discussed during the interview process based on your experience and the time commitment we land on.

How This Starts

We'll start with a 30 day paid trial. If we both feel the fit, we'll extend into a longer engagement. After 90 days, we'll talk about what the long term looks like.

To Apply

Fill out the application form here: 
 



One question will ask if there's anything else you'd like me to know. Please include the word "Apple" in your response so I know you read this whole thing.



I read every application personally.

Namaste, Dr. Tiffany

title: Short-Form Video Editor
description:
Short-Form Video Editor (Premiere Pro + After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve), 

Full-Time Remote, UK Agency



About Us

We're a London-based creative content consultancy producing short-form 

social content for a small portfolio of growing brands. Tight team, fast 

pace, no bureaucracy. Strict NDA on client names.



The Role

You'll edit 10 to 20 short-form pieces per week in Premiere Pro with After 

Effects, or DaVinci Resolve with Fusion — your call, work in whichever you 

ship fastest in. Footage and assets are delivered to you via Frame.io and 

Google Drive. You cut, caption, motion-design, sound-design, colour, and 

export to spec. We review, you revise, we ship.



What you'll be editing (three repeating formats)



1) Podcast clips, talking-head with motion design

   60 to 90 second vertical cuts pulled from long-form podcast recordings. 

   Two-camera setup, separate audio tracks. Punchy hooks in the first 3 

   seconds, animated captions on-brand, lower thirds, light motion graphics 

   (kinetic type, callouts, simple transitions). Sometimes paired with a 

   matching square carousel for LinkedIn (5 to 8 slides in After Effects 

   or Resolve Fusion, exported as PNGs or 1x1 video).



2) Talking-head videos with supplied B-roll

   30 to 90 second vertical or square edits where we send you the A-roll 

   (presenter to camera) and a B-roll package. You cut the talking head 

   tightly, motivate B-roll insertions, add captions, light sound design, 

   colour-match A and B-roll. No need to source footage — it's all supplied.



3) Static and animated carousels (occasional)

   LinkedIn and Instagram square carousels built from supplied copy and 

   brand templates. 5 to 10 slides. Sometimes a short animated version for 

   the lead slide.



Weekly deliverables

- 10 to 20 short-form pieces, mostly 15 to 90 seconds

- Burned-in captions, brand-styled per client, accurate to audio

- B-roll cutaways motivated by content (not pasted on top)

- Light motion design (kinetic captions, callouts, lower thirds, end cards)

- Clean H.264 exports to platform spec (1080x1920, 1080x1080, 1920x1080)

- Organised project files returned to shared drive



Must have

- Fluent in either Premiere Pro + After Effects OR DaVinci Resolve + Fusion

- Strong captioning craft (kinetic, on-brand, accurate, not auto-generated 

  garbage)

- Portfolio of at least 5 short-form edits you personally cut, including 

  at least one podcast clip and one talking-head with B-roll

- Fluent written and conversational English

- Wired internet, minimum 50 Mbps down / 20 up

- Machine able to run your chosen software smoothly, minimum 16GB RAM, 

  dedicated GPU

- Daily 4-hour overlap with UK hours (3pm to 11pm Manila works)



Nice to have

- Real motion design chops (kinetic type, simple 2D animation in AE or Fusion)

- Carousel and static design (Photoshop, Illustrator, or Figma)

- Sound design and audio cleanup (iZotope RX, Fairlight, Audition)

- Real colour grading beyond auto-balance

- Familiarity with Frame.io, Notion, Slack



Pay

£500/month flat (approx PHP 35,000), paid via Wise on the 1st. 

60-day review for raise to £550 to £650 based on quality and ownership.

Paid trial task before hire: $40 USD flat on delivery.

13th-month bonus paid in December as standard.



Mon to Fri, 6 to 8 hours daily. Your weekends are yours.



How to apply

1. Start your
 with the word "PARSNIP" as the first line.

2. Send to 

   a) A 60-second Loom introducing yourself, showing your editing machine, 

      and explaining one decision you made on a recent edit and why.

   b) Links to 3 short-form edits you personally cut. At least one podcast 

      clip and one talking-head with B-roll. Tell me which one you're most 

      proud of and which one you'd redo.

   c) Screenshot of fast.com speed test and your software version numbers.

   d) Your monthly rate expectation.

   e) One sentence: "What's the most common mistake editors make on 

      the first 3 seconds of a short-form video?"

3. Subject line: PARSNIP, Short-Form Editor, [Your Name]



We respond within 5 working days to every application.

title: Product & Ad Researcher — Meta Ads Library / Trendtrack (Dropshipiping Company)
description:
We run two beauty and health e-commerce brands targeting a 40+ audience. We're looking for a researcher who can consistently find ads for products that are already proven and actively scaling — meaning campaigns with significant spend behind them, multiple creatives running, and clear traction in the market right now.



This is not a product discovery role. We are not looking for untested products or early signals. We want ads for products that are already winning — your job is to find them, document them, and deliver structured swipe files we can build our own creatives from.



What you'll do:

Search Meta Ads Library and Trendtrack for products with active, scaled campaigns — high spend signals, multiple ad variants, long run times

Identify advertisers who are clearly investing heavily in a product right now, not just testing

Deliver structured swipe reports per ad: product, hook summary, angle, format, estimated spend signal, and why it's working

Flag recurring hooks and angles across multiple advertisers in the same niche — patterns matter

Submit research on a consistent daily/weekly schedule with clean, organised output





What we're looking for:

Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Library and Trendtrack — you know how to read spend signals, creative volume, and ad longevity

Ability to tell the difference between a product being tested and a product being scaled — this is the core skill

Basic understanding of direct-response hooks and angles (you don't need to write them, but you need to recognise them)

Experience in beauty, health, or supplement e-commerce is a strong plus

Reliable and self-managed — delivers clean output without follow-up needed



What to include in your application:

Brief overview of your experience with Meta Ads Library and Trendtrack specifically

A sample swipe file or research output — show us how you identify a scaled winner, not just any ad you found

The niches you've researched most

Your availability and preferred rate

title: Amazon Private Label Operations Specialist
description:
Position: Amazon Private Label Operations Specialist

Type: Full-Time, Remote/Hybrid (Philippines)

Salary: PHP 30,000 – 45,000 / month, depending on experience

Schedule: Full-time PH daytime hours, with flexibility for supplier and Amazon-related communication



About our Company



We are a Canadian corporation specialized in international trade and e-commerce. We are operating in the global market, and we want to utilize global ecommerce platforms such as Amazon to develop new brands and products and reach out to customers across globe. Our company values professionalism, data-driven decision-making, and long-term partnerships. We are establishing a strong, world-class team in the Philippines.



Role Overview



We are seeking an Amazon Private Label Operations Specialist who can support the full Amazon private label process from product research and supplier sourcing through listing preparation, launch execution, post-launch monitoring, inventory coordination, and ongoing Amazon account support.



This is an execution-focused role for someone with direct Amazon FBA or Amazon private label experience. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, comfortable with Amazon tools and Seller Central workflows, and able to move tasks forward without constant supervision.



NOTE: General VA, Shopify, dropshipping, social media, customer service, or non-Amazon e-commerce experience alone is not suitable for this role. Candidates must have direct Amazon experience.



Key Responsibilities:



• Conduct Amazon product research using tools such as Helium 10, Keepa, Amazon search, and other available Amazon research tools.

• Analyze Amazon product demand, pricing, competition, reviews, profitability, keyword opportunities, and launch difficulty.

• Source and communicate with suppliers through Alibaba, 1688, Global Sources, and other sourcing platforms.

• Request and compare supplier quotes, MOQ, lead time, sample cost, customization options, packaging options, and shipping details.

• Support product development by organizing supplier information, product specifications, sample notes, cost comparisons, and improvement opportunities.

• Review customer feedback and competitor listings to identify product improvements, common complaints, differentiation opportunities, and positioning ideas.

• Support Amazon listing preparation, including keyword research, title and bullet point inputs, image requirements, A+ content inputs, competitor listing review, and product positioning.

• Coordinate with designers, copywriters, PPC specialists, suppliers, prep centers, freight forwarders, or other contractors when needed.

• Assist with Amazon launch preparation, including listing readiness, inventory planning, shipment coordination, launch checklist tracking, and follow-up on missing items.

• Support Amazon Seller Central operations, including listing monitoring, account health checks, suppressed listing follow-up, inventory status review, customer feedback monitoring, and issue tracking.

• Monitor post-launch performance, including sales, keyword movement, conversion signals, customer reviews, returns, stock level, pricing, PPC coordination, and competitor activity.

• Prepare clear reports, updates, and action lists for management review.

• Keep Google Drive, Google Sheets, supplier records, product files, and Amazon operation trackers organized and updated.

• Flag risks, mistakes, delays, supplier issues, listing issues, inventory issues, or Amazon account concerns early.



Qualifications:



• 2-4 years of direct Amazon FBA or Amazon private label experience required; candidates with 4+ years of relevant Amazon experience are preferred.

• Experience with Amazon product research, Amazon listing preparation, supplier sourcing, and Amazon operations support.

• Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central, Helium 10, Keepa, Alibaba, Google Sheets, and Google Drive.

• Strong understanding of Amazon product research, keyword research, competitor analysis, review analysis, pricing, and profitability checks.

• Experience communicating with suppliers and following up professionally.

• Strong English communication skills, especially in writing.

• Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to follow SOPs and structured processes.

• Comfortable using spreadsheets, templates, checklists, AI tools, and Amazon research tools while verifying information carefully.

• Able to work independently, manage multiple product tasks, and provide clear updates.

• Must be comfortable with both pre-launch and post-launch Amazon private label operations.

• Must be up-to-date with AI tools and actively use them to improve research quality, analysis, judgment, decision-making, and workflow speed.





KPIs / Success Measures:



• Accurate and timely completion of Amazon product research, supplier sourcing, and operation files.

• Quality of supplier outreach, quote comparison, sample coordination, and follow-up.

• Accuracy of Amazon market data, competitor analysis, keyword research, and listing preparation inputs.

• Clear and timely communication of blockers, risks, next steps, and completed work.

• Improvement in workflow speed, file organization, and task completion quality.

• Low error rate in data entry, supplier details, Amazon listing details, and research reports.

• Reliable support across product research, sourcing, launch preparation, Seller Central follow-up, and post-launch monitoring.

• Ability to identify issues early before they affect launch timing, listing quality, inventory availability, or account performance.

• Consistent, organized daily updates and clear reporting to management.

• Consistent ability to follow company instructions, SOPs, policies, and communication standards.





What We Offer:



• Full-time remote work opportunity with a Canadian company.

• Long-term opportunity as the Amazon private label business grows.

• Structured SOPs, templates, and workflow support.

• Direct communication with company management.

• Opportunity to work across the full Amazon private label process from product research to post-launch operations.

• Performance-based growth opportunities.

- are organized and reliable

- understand automation logic

- enjoy operational problem solving

- API integrations

- prompt engineering

• building AI workflows

• setting up automations

• organizing internal systems

• documenting processes

• optimizing repetitive operations

___________________________________________________

• troubleshooting automation issues

• optimizing operational systems

• refining prompts and workflows

• improving efficiency

___________________________________________________

• helping scale operations

• reducing admin friction

• supporting future automation initiatives

• improving operational efficiency continuously



Compensation:

USD $10–15+/hour depending on strategic contribution and leadership



_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Documentation & System Design Expectations



We highly value:



• clean workflows

• modular systems

• thoughtful operational design

• clear documentation

• maintainable automation architecture



Important:

Systems should be built in a way that can be easily understood, maintained, and improved by future tea
mbers if needed.



We prefer:

• simple and scalable workflows

• organized databases and naming structures

• modular automations

• clear SOPs and Loom walkthroughs

over overly complex or difficult-to-maintain systems.



All workflows, automations, SOPs, prompts, databases, and operational systems created for Reeljoy will belong to the company upon payment.



Additional expectations:

• Documentation is required for every major workflow

• Clear naming conventions should be used

• Workflows should avoid unnecessary complexity

• Systems should be transferable and maintainable long-term



_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



How to Apply



Please send your application to: 



Include:

1. Resume / portfolio / LinkedIn

2. 1–3 examples of workflows or automations you’ve built (screenshots, Loom videos, or short explanations are fine)



Please answer:



1. What’s the most useful workflow you’ve built and why?

2. If you were helping a content studio become more efficient, what would you automate first?

3. How do you usually document the systems you build?



Shortlisted candidates will go through:

title: Customer Support Experts Needed
description:
We are now hiring Customer Support Experts to assist our customers over the phone.

This is a full-time position only with long-term potential



Customers will call us and ask for assistance with various tasks, such as:



Checking their email accounts

Purchasing items they need

Signing up for services

Logging into or managing their accounts

Checking or signing up for credit score reports

Conducting general online searches



The tasks we handle are all things that can be done online.



PAY & EARNING STRUCTURE



Base rate starts at $4.50 per hour.

Agents usually work 10 hours per day including the paid breaks, and we allow more hours if someone wants to earn more.

During busy times, we also pay time-and-a-half overtime when we need additional coverage.

Good performers can earn a monthly bonus between $60 and $150.

There is a $50 monthly attendance bonus for consistent on-time performance.

Every 6 months, we evaluate performance and agents can receive up to an extra $0.50 per hour added to their rate if they are doing well.



With base hours plus bonuses and performance increases, a strong performer can earn up to around $1,100 per month.



This is the roadmap of our hiring process:



- You will take a quiz that typically takes about an hour to complete.

- If you pass the quiz, you will be invited to take two live mock calls or skill tests. The first one usually takes around 20 minutes, and the second one is longer, typically about an hour.

- Once you pass, you will then proceed with orientation and training.



Please note that our quizzes and skill tests can be challenging for beginners and require sharpness, speed and excellent attention to details. If you believe you possess these skills, feel free to apply.



You need to have fluent English as well as having very good internet connection and a quiet place to work.

Please apply only if you are fully available for a full-time position.

Please do not apply if you are not based in the Philippines.



When You Apply*



Please answer the following questions:



1. How many hours are you available daily, and on which days of the week?

2. How soon are you ready to start?



Lastly, please include a link to a Vocaroo audio recording (minimum 45 seconds) where you briefly introduce yourself. Tell us a bit about your background, relevant experience, and one hobby you genuinely enjoy. This is a voice account and you will be supporting customers, so it's essential that you send a high-quality voice recording.



Thanks,

Alfred

title: Amazon FBA Wholesale Product Research, Sourcing & Supplier Operations Specialist
description:
Position: Amazon FBA Wholesale Product Research, Sourcing & Supplier Operations Specialist

Type: Full-Time, Remote (Philippines)

Salary: PHP 25,000 - 45,000 / month, depending on experience

Schedule: Full-time PH daytime hours, with flexibility for supplier, distributor, and Amazon-related communication



About our Company



We are a Canadian corporation specialized in international trade, wholesale, and e-commerce. We are building Amazon wholesale and private label operations in Canada and the United States, with a focus on long-term supplier relationships, organized execution, and data-driven decision-making. Our company values professionalism, clear communication, and practical execution. We are establishing a strong, world-class team in the Philippines.



Role Overview



We are seeking an Amazon FBA Wholesale Product Research, Sourcing & Supplier Operations Specialist to execute and manage key parts of our Amazon wholesale workflow across Canada and the United States. This role combines Amazon wholesale product research, supplier sourcing, distributor and brand outreach, account applications, onboarding, follow-ups, and daily workflow execution.



This is a main execution role, not a passive support role. The main purpose is to find and validate viable Amazon wholesale opportunities, build and manage the supplier pipeline, keep supplier and product files organized, and move the workflow forward without constant supervision.

The exact focus may shift depending on business priorities, supplier responses, available catalogs, and current workflow bottlenecks.



NOTE: General VA, Shopify, dropshipping, social media, customer service, or basic admin experience alone is not suitable for this role. Candidates must have direct Amazon product research, Amazon wholesale, supplier sourcing, supplier communication, or e-commerce operations experience.



Key Responsibilities:



• Conduct Amazon wholesale product research using Amazon, Keepa, SellerAmp, Seller Central, Google Sheets, and other available Amazon research tools.

• Evaluate product demand, pricing, Buy Box behavior, FBA competition, seller count, Amazon presence, reviews, sales rank, gating status, brand restrictions, and estimated profitability.

• Screen supplier catalogs, wholesale price lists, brand search results, distributor product lists, and product files to identify viable Amazon wholesale opportunities.

• Research and identify potential wholesale distributors, brands, manufacturers, and suppliers in Canada and the United States.

• Contact suppliers, distributors, and brands by
 or web form and follow up professionally.

• Complete wholesale account applications, supplier forms, distributor onboarding forms, and account setup documents.

• Request and organize wholesale pricing, catalogs, MOQ, case pack details, stock availability, lead times, shipping terms, payment terms, and account requirements.

• Confirm whether suppliers allow Amazon, FBA, online marketplace sales, reseller accounts, or require written marketplace approval.

• Maintain supplier trackers, distributor trackers, application status sheets, outreach logs, product screening files, and follow-up lists.

• Organize supplier folders, application screenshots, pricing lists, catalog files, account notes, product research notes, and communication records in Google Drive.

• Coordinate with prep centers, suppliers, distributors, and internal tea
mbers when needed.

• Use AI tools to draft, organize, summarize, and check work, while carefully verifying accuracy.

• Prepare clear daily updates showing completed work, links, blockers, risks, and next steps.

• Flag supplier issues, application blockers, missing documents, marketplace restrictions, pricing problems, weak products, poor-fit suppliers, or workflow delays early.

• Support both Amazon Canada and Amazon US wholesale workflows as the business expands.



Qualifications:



• 2-4 years of direct Amazon FBA wholesale experience required, including Amazon product research, wholesale product screening, supplier sourcing, distributor outreach, brand outreach, Amazon operations, and wholesale account setup.

• Hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central, Keepa, SellerAmp, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Gmail, supplier catalogs, wholesale price lists, and distributor application workflows required.

• Strong understanding of wholesale product viability, including demand, pricing, competition, Buy Box, seller count, Amazon presence, fees, profitability, gating, and brand restrictions.

• Strong written English and professional supplier communication skills.

• Highly organized and able to manage multiple product research tasks, supplier conversations, applications, files, follow-ups, and status trackers at the same time.

• Comfortable following SOPs, checklists, templates, company instructions, policies, and structured workflows.

• Strong attention to detail with product data, pricing, supplier information, application forms, account requirements, and status tracking.

• Able to work independently, take ownership of tasks, and keep work moving without constant supervision.

• Comfortable asking clear questions, reporting blockers early, and providing practical updates.

• Must be comfortable with both Amazon product research and supplier-side communication, not only one side of the workflow.

• Must be reliable, responsive, and consistent with daily execution.

• Must be up-to-date with AI tools and actively use them to improve research quality, analysis, judgment, decision-making, and workflow speed.



KPIs / Success Measures:



• Quality and accuracy of Amazon wholesale product research and screening decisions.

• Ability to identify viable wholesale opportunities and reject weak products or poor-fit suppliers quickly.

• Number and quality of relevant suppliers, distributors, brands, catalogs, and product opportunities researched.

• Quality and consistency of supplier, distributor, and brand outreach.

• Accuracy and completeness of wholesale applications, onboarding files, supplier records, and product research files.

• Speed and quality of follow-ups without losing professionalism or accuracy.

• Organization of Google Drive folders, trackers, supplier records, product screening files, and daily work files.

• Ability to identify supplier restrictions, Amazon marketplace issues, gating issues, application blockers, pricing issues, and workflow risks early.

• Low error rate in forms, supplier details, pricing data, product information, and tracking sheets.

• Clear communication of completed work, blockers, risks, action items, and next steps.

• Ability to take ownership of the wholesale workflow and improve execution over time.

• Consistent ability to follow company instructions, SOPs, policies, and communication standards.



What We Offer:



• Full-time remote/hybrid work opportunity with a Canadian company.

• Long-term opportunity as the Amazon wholesale business grows.

• Structured SOPs, templates, and workflow support.

• Direct communication with company management.

• Opportunity to work across Amazon product research, wholesale sourcing, supplier operations, and marketplace expansion.

• Opportunity to grow into a more senior role as the business reaches revenue and expands.

• Performance-based growth opportunities.

1.Start your message with FUNNELS

Funnels you’ve built

What EXACT steps would you take?”

title: Recruiting Assistant and Candidate Sourcer (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
Job Description:



We're a recruiting agency based in the US that places creative strategists and marketing professionals at e-commerce and DTC brands. We're growing fast and need a sharp, detail-oriented person to help us find and vet candidates through online conversations and data scraping tools.



This is not a traditional VA role. You'll be actively sourcing candidates using tools like Apollo, Phantom Buster, Hunter, Snov, Clay, and similar platforms to build targeted prospect lists. Then you'll be having real conversations with those candidates on LinkedIn and other platforms, learning about their background, evaluating their experience, and determining whether they'd be a good fit for our clients.



If you're someone who knows how to use scraping and enrichment tools to find the right people at scale, can hold a professional conversation in English, and enjoys the intersection of research and human interaction, this role will be a great fit.



What You'll Do



Use data scraping and enrichment tools (Apollo, Phantom Buster, Hunter, Snov, Clay, or similar) to build targeted candidate prospect lists at scale. Find creative strategists and marketing professionals through LinkedIn, job boards, online communities, and scraped data. Send outreach messages to potential candidates using scripts and templates we provide. Have back-and-forth DM conversations with interested candidates to learn about their experience, skills, and what they're looking for. These conversations follow a guide we provide but should feel natural, not scripted. Collect key information from each conversation including background, experience level, portfolio, salary expectations, availability, and how they think about their work. Organize and update all candidate information in our CRM (Airtable). Flag strong candidates for the founder to review. Send polite decline messages to candidates who aren't a fit. Follow up with candidates who haven't responded. Monitor our LinkedIn job listing for new applicants and reach out to promising ones. Research candidates before conversations by checking their LinkedIn profile and any available portfolio or work samples. Keep detailed notes on every interaction.



Who You Are



Strong written English. This is the most important requirement. You'll be having professional conversations with people in the US, UK, and other English-speaking countries. Your messages need to read naturally, with proper grammar, spelling, and a conversational tone.



Experienced with scraping and prospecting tools. You've used Apollo, Phantom Buster, Hunter, Snov, Clay, or similar tools to build prospect lists and find contact information. You know how to set up searches, run scrapes, enrich data, and organize the output into clean usable lists. If you've built lead generation systems before, even better.



Good with people. Even through text, you can build rapport quickly. You're naturally curious and good at getting people to open up about their experience.



Organized and detail-oriented. You'll be managing conversations with dozens of candidates at different stages simultaneously. Nothing falls through the cracks.



Self-motivated. You'll be given daily targets and a clear process. You manage your own time and hit your targets consistently.



Good judgment. Not every candidate who responds is a good fit. You can read a conversation and sense whether someone is strong, average, or not worth pursuing.



Comfortable with technology. You'll be using LinkedIn, Airtable, Google Workspace, scraping tools, and potentially other platforms. You should be comfortable learning new tools quickly.



Required Experience



Strong written English communication skills. Non-negotiable.

Hands-on experience with at least one data scraping or prospecting tool (Apollo, Phantom Buster, Hunter, Snov, Clay, or similar).

Experience building prospect lists or lead lists in a professional setting.

Experience using LinkedIn in a professional capacity.

Experience with any CRM, database, or spreadsheet tool (Airtable, Google Sheets, HubSpot, or similar).

Experience in any role that involved outreach, research, recruiting, lead generation, or candidate communication.



Preferred Experience (Not Required)



Previous experience in recruiting, sourcing, or talent acquisition.

Familiarity with the marketing, advertising, or e-commerce industry.

Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

Experience setting up automated scraping workflows or multi-tool prospecting systems.



**Schedule**



Full-time. Must be available during US business hours for at least 5 to 6 hours of overlap with Eastern Standard Time.



How to Apply



Send a short message introducing yourself. Tell me about any experience you have with outreach, research, recruiting, or candidate communication. Mention which scraping and prospecting tools you've used and how you've used them. Include your LinkedIn profile if you have one. Write your application in your own words. Do not use AI to write it. I want to see how you communicate naturally because that's the core of this role.



We'll send a short test to qualified applicants before making a final decision.

 during work hours with fast response time (under 30 min)

title: Luxury Event Concierge Specialist
description:
We are a luxury event-planning company based in Los Angeles, specializing in premium picnics, proposals, birthdays, baby showers, bridal showers, tablescapes, and private celebrations.



We are looking for a reliable, polished, and highly detail-oriented Luxury Event Concierge Specialist to support client communication, lead follow-ups, reservations, payments, and event coordination.



This is a client-facing luxury concierge role, not a basic Virtual Assistant position. We need someone who can communicate professionally with US clients, guide leads through the booking process, handle pricing conversations, notice missing details, and take ownership without repeated reminders.



The right person is calm, organized, proactive, and comfortable helping clients move from first inquiry to confirmed booking.



This role starts at 20 hours/week, with the opportunity to grow into 30–40 hours/week for the right person.



Work Hours



Our main business hours are 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM PT / California time.



The exact schedule will be discussed during the hiring process, but we are looking for someone who can commit to a consistent part-time schedule of approximately 4 hours per day, 5 days per week.



What This Role Really Means



You will help protect the client experience from inquiry to event day.



You will be responsible for making sure leads are followed up with, clients receive clear answers, reservations are organized, payments are tracked, and missing details are noticed before they become problems.



This role requires someone who can think ahead, communicate clearly, and help keep the business organized every day.



Responsibilities

- Respond to client inquiries by
, phone, text, and messages

- Handle client calls professionally and confidently

- Follow up with leads and help convert inquiries into bookings

- Guide clients through packages, pricing, availability, and booking steps

- Handle pricing questions and objections in a polished, professional way

- Add new reservations and update client records

- Track payments, balances, event details, and client notes

- Review upcoming events for missing details, timing issues, or unclear requests

- Prepare client messages, summaries, and internal updates

- Support event planners with organized reservation information

- Help create and update event checklists when needed

- Use tools such as Gmail, Google Sheets, Asana, Stripe, and ChatGPT

- Escalate urgent or unclear situations before they become problems

- Help maintain a luxury-level client experience from inquiry to event day



Must-Have Requirements

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Confident speaking with US clients by phone

- Experience in customer success, sales, hospitality, events, weddings, travel, concierge service, or premium customer service

- Strong follow-up skills and comfort helping turn inquiries into bookings

- Ability to handle pricing questions professionally

- Very strong attention to detail with dates, times, payments, client requests, and event notes

- Reliable, proactive, and able to complete work without repeated reminders

- Comfortable with spreadsheets, admin work, and structured processes

- Fast internet, quiet workspace, and professional communication style

- Backup plan for internet or power issues, such as hotspot, mobile access, or another reliable work location

- Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT to improve drafts, summaries, and templates



Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate has experience supporting premium clients and understands that tone, timing, accuracy, and follow-up matter.



You may be a strong fit if you:

-Can write polished and natural client messages

- Are comfortable with both sales follow-up and client support

- Can organize details without constant supervision

- Notice missing information before it creates a problem

- Know when to answer directly and when to escalate

- Stay calm and professional under pressure

- Want a long-term role with growth potential



Please Do Not Apply If

- You are looking for a basic VA/admin role only

- You are not comfortable speaking with clients by phone

- You need repeated reminders to complete tasks

- You are not detail-oriented with dates, times, payments, and client requests

- You are uncomfortable with sales follow-ups or pricing conversations

- You prefer step-by-step instructions for every small task

- You do not have reliable internet or a backup plan for remote work issues



Compensation

Starting at $6–$8/hour, depending on experience, phone confidence, sales ability, and relevant background.



This role starts at 20 hours/week, with potential to grow into 30–40 hours/week for the right person.



Performance bonuses and pay increases may be available after the probation period based on reliability, client communication, lead follow-up, booking support, attention to detail, and overall ownership.



We are looking for someone who can prove strong communication, judgment, reliability, and attention to detail before moving into a long-term role.



To Apply



Please answer all questions below. Applications without complete answers will not be reviewed.



1. What experience do you have with luxury clients, events, hospitality, weddings, travel, concierge service, sales, or premium customer service?

2. Describe a time when you helped close a client, saved a client relationship, or handled a difficult customer professionally.

3. Have you handled phone calls with US clients? Please describe the type of calls and your comfort level.

4. A client says: “Your picnic is too expensive. Other companies are cheaper.” Write your professional reply.

5. A client asks for a proposal picnic quote but does not respond after receiving pricing. Write your follow-up message.

6. You are reviewing tomorrow’s events and notice that one client has not paid the remaining balance and the final location is not confirmed. What would you do?

7. Your power or internet goes out during your shift. What is your backup plan and how would you notify the team?

8. Are you available during 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM California time? Please share your preferred schedule and confirm if you are open to Tuesday–Saturday availability.

9. In the first line of your application, write: “I understand this is a client-facing luxury event concierge role.”



Please attach your most recent resume/CV. Thank you.

 prospective and existing customers regarding available capacity and business opportunities

* Provide backup operational and administrative support as needed

 Qualifications



* Previous experience in freight brokerage, trucking, dispatch, or logistics coordination preferred

* Familiarity with TMS platforms and transportation operations

* Strong communication and organizational skills

* Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-moving environment

* Comfortable speaking with drivers, customers, and carriers professionally

* Proficient with
, spreadsheets, and basic computer systems

* Self-motivated and capable of working independently

* Experience with CRM systems is a plus



Preferred Skills



* Knowledge of freight dispatching and asset-based operations

* Problem-solving mindset and sense of urgency

* Ability to adapt to changing schedules and operational needs

* Attention to detail and strong follow-through



Compensation

 Ideal Candidate

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper
description:
Part-Time Bookkeeper - 10 hrs/week, Long-Term, QBO ProAdvisor Preferred



I run a bookkeeping and accounting practice and am looking for an experienced bookkeeper to take on daily work for a few of my higher-volume clients. This is a long-term role with consistent weekly hours and a predictable schedule.



ABOUT THE WORK



You'll be handling daily and recurring monthly bookkeeping tasks across multiple client accounts in QuickBooks Online. To start, this role covers two clients at roughly one hour per day each, five days a week. The accounts require daily attention, so the person in this role needs to be someone who can commit to working on them every business day, not in occasional batches. There is potential to take on additional hours in the future if you're interested in growing the engagement.



Typical work includes daily transaction categorization and review, bank and credit card reconciliations, recurring monthly close tasks, and other client-specific processes I'll train you on.



ONBOARDING AND ONGOING SCHEDULE



For roughly the first two months, we'll meet via Google Meet from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM EST, Monday through Friday. This is a recurring commitment, so you'll need to be reliably available during that block.



In the early weeks, I'll walk you through each account and demo the processes. Over time, you'll take more ownership of those sessions and start running the work yourself. After onboarding wraps up, you'll continue working the accounts on a set daily schedule that we agree on together (there is flexibility here, but the schedule will need to be consistent and within EST 7am-6pm). The total time commitment is approximately 10 hours per week to start.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



- Experienced bookkeeper, ideally a QBO ProAdvisor or with equivalent hands-on QBO experience

- Reliable and available for a fixed daily schedule, long-term

- Follows documented processes closely and accurately; extreme attention to detail is imperative

- Brings observations and improvement ideas forward as you work in the accounts, rather than just executing silently

- Strong written communication for client-adjacent work and internal handoffs

- Comfortable on Google Meet and Google Workspace

- Experience with Financial Cents or a similar practice management platform is a plus

- Experience with construction bookkeeping (cost accounting) is a plus



LOGISTICS



- US 1099 contractor role

- Remote

- Approximately 10 hours per week to start, with potential to expand

- Long-term engagement (this is not a short-term project)



TO APPLY



In your application, please tell me:



1. Your QBO experience, including ProAdvisor status if applicable

2. Whether you have any additional experience mentioned in the 'who I'm looking for' section above

2. Whether the 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM Eastern window works for you Monday through Friday

3. Whether you are comfortable with face-to-face meetings on Google Meet

4. A brief example of a time you noticed and flagged something that improved a client's books or process

title: Operations Manager (Credit Repair, Marketing & Real Estate Operations)
description:
WHO WE ARE



We are a dual-pillar business operating at the intersection of real estate acquisition and credit-driven business funding. On the real estate side, we specialize in creative financing — subject-to deals, cold outreach on vacant, pre-foreclosure, and tax-lien properties. On the funding side, we help small business owners clean up their credit profiles and unlock $50K–$150K+ in business capital to scale through hiring, advertising, and infrastructure.

Both businesses are growing fast. We are not looking for someone to maintain the status quo. We are building the infrastructure to scale, and we need the right operator at the center of it.



THE ROLE

This is not a coordinator position. You are the operational backbone of two businesses. You will manage talent, oversee execution, own systems, and ensure both pillars perform at a high level — simultaneously. You will be the primary point of contact between leadership and the team. Decisions that used to wait will now have a home with you.

If you are someone who needs to be told what to do every step of the way, this is not the role for you. If you thrive in ambiguity, move fast, build structure where there is none, and hold people accountable to outcomes — read on.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



CREDIT REPAIR OPERATIONS

    •    Oversee day-to-day credit repair operations and client fulfillment from onboarding through resolutionEnsure effective use of compliant credit repair methods and workflows across all active client casesManage CRM systems for client onboarding, dispute tracking, and client communicationMonitor KPIs including turnaround times, client progress, and retention ratesImprove and document SOPs to ensure consistency and scalability as the client base grows



MARKETING OPERATIONS

    •    Coordinate and oversee marketing execution across all social media platformsEnsure production of high-quality, attention-grabbing short-form content — Reels, clips, viral editsOversee workflows for content batching, editing standards, transitions, hooks, captions, and CTAsAlign all marketing output with lead generation goals, brand standards, and compliance requirementsServe as the operational bridge between marketing content and sales funnels



REAL ESTATE OPERATIONS & VA MANAGEMENT

    •    Manage and communicate with real estate virtual assistants to ensure daily output and accountabilityEnsure accurate property research and market targeting for subject-to and creative finance opportunitiesOversee CRM workflows for real estate lead intake, tracking, and follow-upCoordinate use of tools including Go High Level and Lead Shepherd to manage pipeline activityAct as liaison between leadership and VA teams to maintain performance standards



TALENT SOURCING & TEAM BUILDING

title: Social Media Content Producer *Superstar Only*

This is the hands-on execution role on the social team. You take creative direction and turn it into finished, polished, published content - fast, clean, and on-brand, every single day.



You will be working directly with a creator who has over 4 million followers across platforms, with Instagram as the primary channel. Our content operation is structured like a studio with batch production, performance metrics, and AI-native systems. You report to the Content Strategist who sets the creative direction and generates the ideas. Your job is to bring those ideas to life - editing, designing, scheduling, publishing, tracking performance, and keeping the entire production machine running smoothly.



This is a full-time remote position. We are looking for a fast, detail-oriented executor who can produce high-quality short-form content at volume, manage publishing workflows across multiple platforms, and actively use AI tools to increase speed and output. A genuine interest in health, beauty, and strong visual aesthetics is essential - this is the world we operate in, and you need to live and breathe it.



Responsibilities

- Produce 2 to 3 short-form videos and supporting graphics per day, including editing, trimming, captioning, and polishing content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

- Execute on creative briefs and direction provided by the Content Strategist, turning concepts into finished, platform-ready assets.

- Design on-brand visuals such as carousels, text graphics, thumbnails, and infographics that support the creator's style and messaging.

- Plan, schedule, and publish short-form content across all platforms while maintaining a balanced mix of educational, inspirational, and trend-based formats.

- Follow short-form trends including audio, hooks, captions, and editing styles, and flag relevant opportunities to the Content Strategist.

- Monitor performance metrics weekly and provide insights, recommendations, and data summaries based on watch time, retention, views, and engagement.

- Source and organize trending sounds, audio, and reference content to support the Content Strategist's ideation process.

- Coordinate collaboration posts and identify smart opportunities for creator crossovers and partnership content.

- Keep systems clean in Asana and Google Drive, ensuring clear task ownership, file naming, version control, and a predictable content runway.

- Use AI tools to streamline editing, captioning, clipping, and repurposing workflows to increase daily output and reduce turnaround time.

- Continuously improve and document production workflows to increase the efficiency and scalability of the content system.



Requirements

- 3+ years of experience creating and publishing short-form content for Instagram, TikTok, and/or YouTube Shorts with proven results.

- Genuine interest in health, beauty, and aesthetics. You naturally follow this space, understand the visual standards, and have an eye for what looks premium.

- Editing and design expertise in short-form video editing using Premiere Pro, CapCut, or Final Cut, and strong design ability using Canva or Photoshop, including thumbnails, carousels, text graphics, and supporting visuals.

- Strong ability to take creative direction and execute it accurately and quickly with minimal revision cycles.

- Deep platform fluency across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and emerging formats, with a clear understanding of distribution mechanics and platform culture.

- Experience managing posting schedules and publishing workflows across multiple platforms, with strong attention to detail, file organization, and systems management.

- Ability to track and interpret performance metrics such as watch time, retention, views, and engagement, and surface insights to inform strategy.

- AI-forward operator who actively uses AI tools in editing and production workflows. Bonus for familiarity with tools such as Runway, VEO or Flow, ChatGPT, or Claude.

- Excellent communication skills for collaborating with the Content Strategist, editors, and cross-functional teams.

- Ability to handle multiple tasks effectively while operating in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.

- Must submit a strong portfolio demonstrating editing, design, and creative execution across multiple short-form formats.

- Recognized for exceptional achievements such as attaining Latin Honors (Summa Cum Laude, Magna Cum Laude, Cum Laude), performance awards, or demonstrating fast career progression into higher roles.



Results

- Social content consistently published within 24 to 48 hours of long-form production wrap.

- Sustained growth in high-quality engagement including shares, saves, retention, and audience sentiment.

- A cohesive, premium social presence that reinforces and amplifies the creator's broader ecosystem.

- Clean, organized production systems with predictable output and minimal missed deadlines.



Requirements for Effective Remote Work

- Reliable computer or laptop capable of video editing.

- High-speed internet connection plus backup.

- Conducive work environment.



Working Schedule

- Full-time remote position.



Compensation

- Salary will be based on skills, speed, portfolio output, and experience.



Benefits

- Competitive salary.

- Paid Time Off from day one, increasing to 10 days annually after six months with the company.

I’m looking for a video editor who can closely match my current editing style and help improve it even more.

Recreate the exact style of my current videos

Edit for high retention, not just basic cuts

Understand English voice-over clearly and match visuals to what is being said

Have a strong sense of visual rhythm and pacing

Add smooth moving images, zooms, effects, pop-ups, transitions, and visual jokes

Make the video feel nostalgic, clean, and entertaining

Keep the edit flowing so viewers don’t get bored



I especially want more moving visuals and effects like in the first 30 seconds of my newest video, “The Weirdest Wii Channels”, but even smoother and more polished.

The full voice-over

Some Wii images and video clips when needed

My Mii mascot in different poses

Notes about the video style and structure



We can discuss whether you will also help search for extra images/videos yourself. Some Wii footage or images may be provided by me because they need to be accurate or untouched.



Style



The videos should feel:



Nostalgic

Funny, but not over-edited

Smooth and easy to watch

Similar to my current channel style

Focused on viewer retention



This is not just basic editing. I need someone who understands timing, movement, and how to make a voice-over visually interesting.



Requirements

Must understand English well

Must understand what the voice-over is saying

Must be able to match visuals to the script

Must be able to follow an existing style closely

Experience with YouTube editing is preferred

Retro gaming / Nintendo / Wii knowledge is a plus

Budget



My budget is $25–$50 per video, negotiable depending on quality, speed, and how much work you can take off my hands.



I’m looking to produce around 1 video per week, so this can become long-term work if we work well together.



How to apply



Please answer these questions:



What editing program do you use?

How much experience do you have with YouTube video editing?

Can you recreate an existing editing style from a reference video?

Do you understand English voice-overs well?

Are you comfortable editing nostalgic / gaming content?

Can you help search for images and clips if needed?

How fast can you usually deliver one video?

Please send examples of videos you edited, preferably YouTube-style content.



Next Step



If your application looks good, you will move on to the next round.



To make sure you read the full post, start your application with:



“Wii Editor”

Ideal

title: Real Estate Sales — Remote (US Hours)
description:
Remote | Full-Time (Mon-Fri) | EST Hours Required

Compensation: $800–$1,200/month Depending on Experience | Performance Bonus based on deals closed | After 1 year: 5 PTO and 6 paid holidays





WHO WE ARE

Ispot Homes is a real estate investment company based in Central Florida. We buy distressed properties across Florida, Ohio, North Carolina, and Georgia. We are a small, fast-moving team — not a corporation. We close deals quickly, communicate clearly, and operate at a high standard. We are growing and we need someone who can keep up.



THE ROLE

You will be the first voice agents hear after our offer system generates a response. Your job is to run Discovery Calls, qualify leads, manage follow-up cadences, and hand hot opportunities to our senior acquisition manager to close.



This is not a data entry role. This is a front-line sales position with a clear process to follow and real accountability attached to it.



If you are looking for easy work — this is not it. If you are a sharp communicator who wants to grow inside a real sales operation — keep reading.



WHAT YOU WILL DO DAILY

Call listing agents who have responded to our MLS offers within 10 minutes of receiving the lead alert

Run structured Discovery Calls using our proven SOP — scripts and training provided

Qualify leads as HOT, WARM, or COLD using our tiered pricing matrix

Log every call, every update, and every next step in our Trello CRM same day

Manage WARM lead follow-up cadence — consistent touches on a defined schedule

Re-engage cold leads on a structured timeline

Escalate HOT leads to senior acquisition manager immediately

Attend weekly team huddle — report pipeline status, flagged deals, and activity numbers

Meet a minimum standard of 30 agent contacts per week



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Required

Fluent English — spoken and written. You will be on the phone with US real estate agents daily. Communication must be clear, confident, and professional.

Prior sales or outbound calling experience — real estate experience preferred but not required

Comfortable making cold and warm calls — this is not optional

Detail-oriented — if it is not logged, it did not happen

Self-directed — you will have a process to follow but no one standing over you

Reliable internet connection and quiet workspace for calls

Available during EST business hours Monday through Friday



Preferred

Background in real estate, wholesaling, or investment sales

Experience with Trello, Google Sheets, or similar CRM tools

Familiarity with MLS listings and basic property terminology

Experience working with US-based clients remotely



WHAT WE PROVIDE

Complete Sales SOP with scripts, objection handling, and call frameworks — you will not be guessing

Trello CRM fully built and ready — no setup required

Tiered lead scoring matrix — you will always know exactly how to classify a lead

Direct coaching from senior acquisition manager on live deals

Weekly team huddle for feedback and deal review

Clear performance standards from day one — no ambiguity on what success looks like

Path to higher compensation as deal volume grows



HOW WE MEASURE YOUR PERFORMANCE

You will be evaluated on four metrics week:

Agent contacts per week — minimum 30

HOT leads identified and escalated within 10 minutes + logged

Trello updated same day on every active lead

WARM leads touched on cadence — no skipped follow-ups



Miss the standard two weeks in a row - we will have a direct conversation about it. Consistently hit the standard - your compensation grows with the business + deal volume.



HOW TO APPLY:

Submit application via LinkedIn then:



Send the following to 

A 60 to 90 second voice recording introducing yourself and telling us why you are the right person for this role.

Attach your resume or work history - brief is fine.

A written paragraph describing a time you handled rejection or pushback in a sales or client-facing role and what you did next.



Applications without the voice recording will not be reviewed.

 What we need

nt you know, not the day it's due
