title: Senior Full-Stack Developer — AI-Augmented Logistics Platform
description:
We're a US-based logistics company building the systems that run our operations end-to-end. We have an initial prototype built using AI tools ("vibe coding"), and we're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Developer to take it from prototype to a production-grade Logistics ERP & Client Portal — while also owning the automation, integrations, and internal tools that keep our team moving fast.



You won't write every line from scratch. We expect you to use AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, etc.) to ship fast, while applying senior-level engineering judgment to make sure security, architecture, and business logic are flawless. If the AI writes bad code, you catch it and fix it.



This is hands-on work across the stack — backend logic, clean frontends, no-code automations, AI integrations, and the secure multi-tenant architecture underneath it all. You'll work directly with the founder/operations lead.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

• Logistics ERP & Client Portal — Architect and build a production-grade system with strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC):

- Internal Ops: Inventory Control, Route Scheduling, Sales Quoting, Accounting.

- Client Portal: A restricted, high-polish view where customers verify items and track orders without seeing internal data.

• Multi-Tenant Security — Ensure complete data separation between clients. Client A must never see Client B's inventory. No exceptions.

• Business Logic — Build the workflows that move us from Quote ? Order ? Delivery ? Invoice.

• Automation workflows — Build and maintain pipelines in n8n, Make, Google Apps Script, and Zapier. Triggers from Gmail, Slack, webhooks, calendars.

• Web development — Landing pages and small web apps using HTML/CSS/Tailwind, React or Next.js. Speed, clean UI, lead capture.

• Internal tool development — Slack apps (Bolt SDK), dashboards, lightweight Node.js or Python services.

• API integrations — Gmail, Google Workspace, Slack, PandaDoc, Google Maps/Mapbox, QuickBooks/Xero, Anthropic Claude API, OpenAI, Gemini, Twilio.

• AI integration — Wire LLMs into existing workflows (quote parsing, lead intake, content generation, internal tools).

• AI-accelerated development — Use Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, etc. to move fast on standard modules (forms, tables, CRUD), then harden everything before it ships.

• Maintenance & iteration — Debug, monitor, improve. We ship fast and refine as we go.



MUST HAVE SKILLS:

• 3+ years of professional experience in full-stack web development or automation engineering

• Portfolio or GitHub with real, deployed projects (not tutorials)

description:
We're hiring ONE dedicated cold caller to drive our outbound acquisitions. You'll be calling motivated property sellers in Oklahoma, following our proven scripts and systems, and setting qualified appointments for our acquisitions team.



This is not a "dial and pray" gig. We have a complete, professional system already built — an 88-page Team Operations Manual, phone scripts, SMS/email templates, drip campaigns, and training tests. You'll study and master these materials before you ever touch a live lead.



HARD REQUIREMENTS (Do not apply without these):



• Hands-on REsimpli experience — You must already know how to navigate REsimpli: update lead statuses, log call dispositions, add notes, manage drip campaigns, and use the built-in dialer. We will NOT train you on REsimpli basics.



• Real estate cold calling experience — At least 6 months of cold calling property sellers (not buyers, not generic telemarketing). You understand seller objections, motivation levels, and how to qualify leads.



• Clear, neutral English — You'll be speaking with property owners across Oklahoma. Your English must be conversational, confident, and easy to understand.



• Reliable internet + quiet workspace — No background noise, no shared call centers. Professional environment only.



• Willingness to study and be tested — Before you make a single call, you will complete our full training program and pass both an open-book and closed-book exam (80% minimum to pass). This is non-negotiable.



Our Training & Onboarding Process:



We don't throw you on the phones and hope for the best. Here's how onboarding works:



Week 1 — Study Phase:

• You'll receive our 88-page Team Operations Manual — covers our entire acquisition system, seller psychology, NEPQ conversation framework, offer formulas, Oklahoma compliance rules, operator cards, battle drills, and default decisions

• You'll also receive our REsimpli Complete Toolkit — 10 phone scripts, 18 SMS templates, 7
 templates, 9 drip campaigns, and 4 task sequences already built and ready to use

• Study both documents thoroughly



Week 1 (End) — Testing:

• Open Book Test — 33 scenario-based questions (you can reference the manual). 80% to pass.

• Closed Book Test — 48 questions fro
mory. 80% to pass.

• If you don't pass, you get one retake. If you don't pass the retake, the trial is over.



Week 2 — Supervised Calling:

• Once you pass both tests, you get REsimpli access and begin live calls

• All calls recorded for QA

• Daily check-ins during Week 2



Week 3+ — Full Production:

• 150–200+ outbound dials per day

• Independent operation within our systems

• Weekly KPI review



What Success Looks Like:



• 150–200+ outbound dials per day

• 2–5+ qualified leads per week

• Accurate REsimpli updates on every call (status, notes, disposition, follow-up tasks)

• All drip campaigns and follow-up sequences triggered correctly

• Professional, empathetic tone with every seller — no high-pressure tactics

• Appointments set for acquisitions team on qualified leads

Nice-to-Haves (not required):



• Experience with Mojo Dialer, BatchDialer, or similar power dialers

• Familiarity with skip tracing tools (BatchLeads, PropStream)

title: Updated: Senior EA / Operations VA for US Medical Consulting Firm — Policy & SOP Review, Notion, Long-Term
description:
Updated Description: Senior EA / Operations VA for US Medical Consulting Firm — Policy & SOP Review, Notion, Long-Term



I have updated the description from my prior job posting, and including questions specifically related to QBO, Outlook, Zapier, Notion, and Healthcare experience. 



I'm a physician and medical director based in Colorado, US. I own a single-physician PLLC that provides medical director services and NP/PA supervision to clinics across multiple US states (IV hydration, med spa, aesthetics, GLP-1, primary care).



I'm hiring one senior person to own the day-to-day operations so I can focus on the medical, compliance, and growth side of the business. This is a long-term, embedded role. If you're looking for a 3-month gig, this isn't it. If you're looking for a business owner you can grow with for years, we may be a good fit.



What you'll own



Policy and SOP review. I have a library of clinic policies, standing orders, supervision agreements, and internal SOPs that support a multi-state practice. I will need you to review them, flag gaps, track versions, and propose edits. You don't need to be a lawyer or clinician, just be willing and able to look up normal policies and compare.



Inbox monitoring and drafting. I get 30 to 60 inbound
s per day. Most are noise; a few are real new-client inquiries, state board notices, or NP/PA collaboration requests. You'll triage, draft responses in my voice for me to approve, and surface what actually needs my attention.



Calendar and scheduling. Managing my availability across consults, clinic onboardings, and personal time.



Occasional client text messages. Same voice-matching skill as
, lower volume.



Client and CRM organization. Keeping records of every clinic, NP, and PA I work with, including contract status, state, audit cadence, supervision agreement renewal dates. This will likely be an automated process we'll be building around; I'm hiring a contractor to build us a program from the ground up.



Google Drive cleanup and ongoing structure. 1.5 years of accumulated documents across multiple state PLLCs need a clean folder taxonomy with naming conventions and version control.



Filtering inbound offers. New clinic inquiries, NP/PA collaboration requests, vendor pitches, and partnership offers come in regularly. You'll triage these against a checklist I'll teach you, surface the real opportunities, and bring the ones with potential to my attention.



Eventually: light QuickBooks Online work, basic AP/AR and invoicing for the PLLC. Training provided if you don't have QBO experience but understand bookkeeping fundamentals.



Tools we use



- Notion (primary source of truth, must have hands-on experience, not just exposure)

- Zapier (current automations; willing to train someone strong who hasn't used it yet)

- Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Docs, Sheets)

- Microsoft Outlook and Calendar

- QuickBooks Online (training provided if you have bookkeeping fundamentals)

- ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity (AI assistance is encouraged, not banned)



What I'm looking for



- 2+ years of real EA or operations VA experience supporting US-based founders, executives, or business owners

- Strong written English, you'll be drafting in my voice and writing to physicians, attorneys, and clinic owners

- Comfortable in healthcare-adjacent work (HIPAA awareness expected; clinical background not required but a plus)

- Proactive, you flag issues early and propose solutions, you don't wait to be asked

- Organized to the point of being a little annoying about it (this is a compliment)

- Discreet, you'll see sensitive business and patient-adjacent information

- Available long-term, full-time, with at least some overlap with US business hours preferred



Who you are not



- Looking for project-based or short-term work

- A pure social media manager, content creator, or copywriter (those skills are nice but not the job)

- Hoping to grow into a clinical role (this is admin-first and will stay that way)

- A generalist who'll need everything explained from scratch, I want someone who walks in with judgment



How to apply



Send me a message that includes all four of the following. Applications that skip any of these will not be reviewed:



1. Briefly tell me about yourself, not a resume dump, just who you are and why this role caught your eye.



2. Walk me through how you'd approach the first 30 days of inbox triage for someone like me, assuming you have access to my inbox and a brief intro to my business. What would you set up first?



3. Explicitly state your hands-on experience with each of the following. For each one, tell me how many years you've used it, what you've actually done with it, and rate yourself: none, basic, intermediate, or advanced. Don't lump them together, give me one line per item.

   - EA or operations VA experience (years supporting US-based founders, executives, or business owners; lead clients you've worked with)

   - QuickBooks Online

   - Microsoft Outlook

   - Zapier

   - Notion

   - Healthcare or HIPAA-adjacent work



4. One question you have for me. Anyone who asks zero questions about the role isn't curious enough for this hire.



I read every application that follows these instructions, and I'll respond within 3 business days to candidates I think would be a good match.



Looking forward to hearing from you.



— Thomas

Long-form is storytelling. It’s retention. It’s the thing that turns a stranger into a believer before they ever book a call.



I need someone who understands pacing, knows when to hold a 
nt and when to cut, and can make a 15-minute vlog feel like it flew by.



The channel is still young. That means whoever joins now helps build the standard instead of inheriting someone else’s template.
